purpose: Define compatibility and migration rules when source schema/profile, field mapping or destination schema versions change, preventing stale mappings from silently producing wrong semantics.

value.binding_rule: Mapping profile binds exact source-profile version and destination-schema version/compatibility range.
value.change_rule: Source/destination version change triggers explicit compatibility evaluation.
value.stale_rule: Stale mapping never continues silently when referenced field identities/types/semantics changed incompatibly.
value.identity_rule: Mapping version/profile identity is separate from source/destination schema identities.
value.migration_rule: Mapping migration is explicit and preserves prior mapping history.
value.test_rule: Compatible mapping claims may require fixtures/conformance tests where declared.
value.failure_rule: Unresolved mapping incompatibility blocks ingest rather than guessing new bindings.
